title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Totally Tubulair Superdrop

paragraphs.text: The Totally Tubulair Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It becomes available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on March 2, 2026.

Adjacent to the release of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles set , this is a Universes Beyond cross-over product based on the multimedia franchise of the same name owned by Viacom ( Paramount Skydance ).

As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card . Occasionally the regular bonus card is replaced by TMNT themed Slime Against Humanity with art by Jon Vermilyea . This card appears in two versions, SLD #7077 features the Turtles with different colored bandanas and SLD #7078 features them all with orange bandanas.
